gist: In the marketing meeting he offers to produce an influencer list from his Dodgers and San Francisco 49ers contacts and a relative who knows Schwarzenegger; in the retreat meeting he asks about horseback riding and about stopping at a theme park in Florida.
notes: The cleanest cross-meeting case: one person, two meetings, no shared vocabulary between the halves. A system retrieving only the marketing meeting answers half and must be scored as missing.
